Contact

For questions, bug reports, and suggestions, please open an issue on GitHub Issues. A GitHub account (free) is required.

Issues are public. Do not include personal information, and only attach sheet music you are allowed to share (for example, music in the public domain or your own). If the reading went wrong, your browser, your computer, and a short description of the score (for example piano, two staves, 3 pages) help.

Disclaimer

  • The app reads sheet music automatically. We do not guarantee that the notes, rhythms, tempo, or anything else it reads, or the information on this site, are correct or complete. Check the result before you rely on it.
  • Use only sheet music you are allowed to use. The app does not send it anywhere, but you are responsible for how you use the results (for example the saved MusicXML).
  • We are not responsible for any loss or damage resulting from the use of this site.
  • Links to other websites are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for their content.
  • The content of this site may be changed or removed, and the service may be stopped, without notice.

Copyright

  • The app reads sheet music with homr, an open-source optical music recognition program licensed under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 (AGPL-3.0). The app's source code is published under the same AGPL-3.0 on GitHub.
  • Other libraries used by the app are listed under Settings → About in the app.
  • The text and images on this site are © 2026 ktkwmr. The sample score is a traditional melody engraved for this site.

Privacy

How this site handles information is described in the privacy policy.

Hear your sheet music

Take a photo of a score or open an image or PDF, and play it with a cursor that follows the staff. Free, no sign-up, and your music stays on your device.
